name: ak:show-off
overview: Create preference-aware self-contained HTML pages to showcase work. Use for demos, visual presentations, interactive showcases.
whenToUse: Invoke to create a self-contained showcase or demo page.

flags.name: --executable-path
flags.desc: Optional Chrome/Chromium executable path. Also reads `CHROME_EXECUTABLE_PATH` or `PUPPETEER_EXECUTABLE_PATH`.
